::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 1st [1880]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: Eng. lett. d. 495 f108
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1444.qmd)

Would you be so kind, in returning the proofs of [‘the angel of Viareggio’](other_books/otherbook_917.qmd) as to address them direct to the printer 

Messrs [Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd) & Taylor
Bread Street Hill
London EC

If they are addressed to the Editor, they remain at the office till a parcel is sent to me, and so we get them too late to profit by your corrections

Yours truly
C M Yonge
